==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Switched roles with [[Caomei]] from top lane to AD Carry.<ref>[http://ggchronicle.com/world-elite-preview-season-two-world-finals World Elite Team Summary] ''ggchronicle.com''</ref>
* His name means "smile" in Chinese.
* Considered by many to be the best AD carry in the world.
* He claims to be good at any AD carry with the sole exception of {{ci|Draven}}, because catching the axes would require too much effort.
* He secured Solo Queue rank 1 during Season 3 on KR servers.<ref>[http://t.qq.com/p/t/218347045582213 Weixiao WeiBo Post] ''t.qq.com''</ref>
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Ezreal}} and {{ci|Vayne}}.<ref>[http://clgaming.net/news/42-interview-with-furrystyle-of-we Interview with Weixiao (Formerly Furrystyle) of WE] ''clgaming.net''</ref>
* His ex-girlfriend Su Xiao-yan (苏小妍) is a famous League of Legends caster in China.
* He became rank 1 Challenger in China on the 5th April 2014 with a W/L of 94/50.<ref>[http://i.imgur.com/izODdBE.png Weixiao #1 Challenger]</ref>
* He is regarded as one of the best AD carries in the history of League of Legends.
* Introduced to LPL Hall of Fame in December 2020.<ref>[http://twitter.com/lplenglish/status/1334138408361357314 LPL's Tweet]</ref>
